description: This file defines the VoiceWakeManager class which manages voice wake-word detection and speech recognition using Android's SpeechRecognizer API. It handles starting/stopping recognition, handling recognition results, and executing commands based on transcribed speech.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice wake word detection and speech recognition, handles recognition lifecycle, processes results, and triggers commands.

methods.name: setTriggerWords
methods.description: Sets the list of trigger words to activate voice commands.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts speech recognition listening.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops speech recognition and updates status.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Starts the listening process with configured Intent.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the speech recognition after a delay.

methods.name: handleTranscription
methods.description: Handles recognized speech, extracts commands, and triggers actions.
